name: route_by_selector_below_six
description: Compares a byte selector with six and jumps through one of two unrecovered pointers, one for values below six and one for all others. It does no other work.

description: Copies a counted block of bytes from the end of a source region toward its start, decrementing the source and destination pointers each step. Once the count reaches minus one it jumps through an unrecovered pointer.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:intro:0:01A6
name: decode_bitstream_copy_stage
description: Walks a bit-packed input word by word, copying literal bytes forward into the output and then copying a run of earlier bytes. It finishes by jumping through an unrecovered pointer.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:intro:0:01AA
name: decode_bitstream_bit_refill_loop
description: Shifts bits out of a packed longword and reloads the next word from the input when the register runs empty. The bits drive literal copies and back-references into a buffer, ending in an unrecovered jump.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:intro:0:01B6
name: decode_bitstream_refill_then_copy
description: Refills the bit register from the input when it is exhausted, then copies literal bytes forward and a run of earlier bytes into the output. It ends with an unrecovered jump.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:intro:0:01C4
name: unpack_backward_literal_runs
description: Copies an initial region forward, then walks an encoded byte stream and writes literal or repeated bytes into the destination backwards. It finishes by jumping through an unrecovered pointer.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:intro:0:0202
name: write_byte_then_enable_dma
description: Stores one byte at the current output position and writes two 16-bit values into a custom chip register block, setting the master DMA enable and interrupt enable bits. It then jumps through an unrecovered pointer.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:intro:0:0216
name: copy_escape_coded_bytes_backwards
description: Copies bytes backwards from a source buffer and treats two marker byte values specially: one marker starts a repeat run and the other ends the copy. It finishes by calling an unrecovered pointer.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:intro:0:0226
name: copy_escape_coded_zero_runs
description: Copies bytes backwards from a source buffer, inserting a run of zero bytes whose length is taken from the byte before it when a marker value appears. One marker value ends the copy, and the routine finishes with an unrecovered jump.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:0000
name: run_animation_sound_sequence
description: Program entry point that loads and plays a sequence of animation and sound data files, touching the DMA control and the joystick and disk status port. It stops ProTracker music replay and then calls the write routine and other other routines in turn.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:0408
name: open_dos_and_graphics_libraries
description: Opens two libraries through the exec open-library call, then requests the DOS output handle, storing each result. It returns zero when all steps succeed and minus one when one of them fails.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:046A
name: close_two_library_bases
description: Calls the exec close-library routine twice, releasing the two library bases that were opened earlier. It makes no checks on the results.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:0488
name: wait_disk_port_or_halt
description: Tests one bit of the CIA port register and, when that bit is set, busy-waits until a register reads a fixed value and then loops forever. Otherwise it returns minus one.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:04B4
name: free_nonzero_memory_blocks
description: Walks eleven saved address and size pairs and frees each one whose two stored words are both nonzero, using the exec free-memory call. It returns zero.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:0650
name: write_error_message_to_output
description: Writes a fixed file access and memory error message to the stored DOS handle using the DOS write call. It returns nothing.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:066E
name: check_file_steps_with_cleanup
description: Clears two file-state fields, stores the given argument, and runs three checks in order, stopping at the first failure. On failure it calls cleanup routines, and it returns zero on success or minus one on failure.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:06B2
name: lock_and_examine_file
description: Locks a file through the DOS lock call and then examines the lock with the DOS examine call. It stores the lock handle and returns zero on success or minus one on failure.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:06FE
name: unlock_stored_file_lock
description: Calls the DOS unlock routine on the stored lock handle, but only when that handle is nonzero. It returns nothing.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:0714
name: open_read_close_file
description: Opens a file through the DOS open call, reads from it, then closes it. It returns zero on success and minus one when the open fails.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:075C
name: allocate_memory_block
description: Allocates a memory block through the exec allocation call, using one of two equivalent request forms, and stores the returned address. It returns zero on success and minus one when the allocation fails.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:07B2
name: free_block_if_allocated
description: Frees the stored memory block through the exec free-memory call, but only when both of its stored words are nonzero. It returns nothing.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:08F2
name: run_coded_command_stream
description: Reads a byte-coded command stream and dispatches on each opcode to set timing, copy small tables, adjust counters or branch within the stream. Between steps it waits on a raster position and a status bit of the CIA port. It returns zero when the stream ends, or minus one if the status bit is clear.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:09F2
name: wait_button_edge_with_flash
description: Waits for a button bit in the pot port register to go low and then high, setting the background color to a fixed red value while it waits. It returns nothing.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:0A2C
name: blit_copy_fixed_region
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, then programs a straight copy of a 40-word wide, 125-row region from source to destination. It starts the blit, waits for it to finish and then turns blitter DMA off.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:0A7C
name: blit_copy_fixed_region_reversed
description: Performs the same fixed 40-word by 125-row blitter copy as its neighbour, but with the two pointer values swapped. It waits for the blitter before and after the operation.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:0ACC
name: blit_clear_fixed_region
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, then starts a blit that writes zeros to a fixed 40-word by 125-row destination region. It waits for completion and turns blitter DMA off.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:0B08
name: fade_palette_colors_down
description: Repeats fifteen steps in which it walks 32 colour words and decreases each 4-bit channel by one, stopping at zero, and waits on a flag between passes. It then stores a timing value.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:0B68
name: allocate_split_buffer_pointers
description: Requests an 80000-byte memory block through the exec allocation call and stores its start as two buffer pointers, the second 40000 bytes further on. It returns zero on success and minus one on failure.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:0BC6
name: free_split_buffer_pointers
description: Frees the 80000-byte buffer through the exec free-memory call, but only when both stored buffer words are nonzero. It returns zero.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:0C12
name: decode_rle_bitplane_rows
description: Decodes a run-length coded bitmap into rows spaced forty bytes apart. Each control byte selects a literal copy, a repeated byte, or a skip, and a zero byte ends the data.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:0C70
name: interpret_stream_timed_entry
description: Enters a byte-coded command interpreter that first waits on a raster position and a CIA port status bit. It then dispatches opcodes for timing, table copies, counters and branches, returning minus one when the status bit is clear and zero at the end of the stream.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:0CCA
name: interpret_stream_copy_entry
description: Starts a byte-coded command interpreter by copying thirty-two entries first, then dispatches the same opcodes for timing, counters and branches. It returns minus one when the CIA status bit is clear and zero at the end of the stream.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:0CE0
name: interpret_stream_direct_entry
description: Loads a value from the stream and enters a byte-coded command interpreter that dispatches opcodes for timing, counters and branches. It returns minus one on a clear CIA status bit and zero at the end of the stream.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:0CEA
name: interpret_stream_skip_entry
description: Enters a byte-coded command interpreter at a point that reads a counter adjustment before dispatching opcodes. It returns minus one on a clear CIA status bit and zero when the stream ends.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:0D14
name: interpret_stream_counter_entry
description: Enters a byte-coded command interpreter that adds a parity-toggled or literal counter value before dispatching opcodes. It returns minus one on a clear CIA status bit and zero when the stream ends.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:0D36
name: interpret_stream_wait_entry
description: Enters a byte-coded command interpreter after a short busy-wait on an input value. It then dispatches opcodes for timing, table copies, counters and branches, returning minus one on a clear CIA status bit and zero at the end of the stream.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:0D52
name: interpret_stream_plain_entry
description: Enters the shared byte-coded command interpreter directly at the current stream pointer, dispatching opcodes for timing, counters and branches. It returns minus one on a clear CIA status bit and zero at the end of the stream.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:0D56
name: interpret_stream_plain_entry
description: Enters the shared byte-coded command interpreter directly at the current stream pointer, dispatching opcodes for timing, counters and branches. It returns minus one on a clear CIA status bit and zero at the end of the stream.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:0D5A
name: interpret_stream_slot_init_entry
description: Initializes one command slot from the stream value, clearing its counter and storing its pointer, then enters the shared command interpreter. It returns minus one on a clear CIA status bit and zero at the end of the stream.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:0D84
name: interpret_stream_entry_b
description: Enters the shared byte-coded command interpreter after a slot lookup from the stream value, dispatching opcodes for timing, counters and branches. It returns minus one on a clear CIA status bit and zero at the end of the stream.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:0DCC
name: interpret_stream_entry_c
description: Enters the shared byte-coded command interpreter after a slot lookup from the stream value, dispatching opcodes for timing, counters and branches. It returns minus one on a clear CIA status bit and zero at the end of the stream.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:0DF8
name: interpret_stream_clear_slot_entry
description: Clears one command slot and enters the shared byte-coded command interpreter. It returns minus one on a clear CIA status bit and zero at the end of the stream.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:0DFE
name: interpret_stream_fill_slot_entry
description: Stores a value into a command slot and enters the shared byte-coded command interpreter. It returns minus one on a clear CIA status bit and zero at the end of the stream.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:0E0C
name: interpret_stream_load_slot_entry
description: Loads a saved slot pointer from the stream value and enters the shared byte-coded command interpreter. It returns minus one on a clear CIA status bit and zero at the end of the stream.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:0E26
name: interpret_stream_call_helper_entry
description: Calls another routine and then enters the shared byte-coded command interpreter. It returns minus one on a clear CIA status bit and zero at the end of the stream.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:0E2E
name: build_command_slot_table_entry
description: Builds a table of slot addresses from a list of offsets stored in memory, then enters the shared byte-coded command interpreter. It returns minus one on a clear CIA status bit and zero at the end of the stream.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:0E68
name: interpret_stream_save_return_entry
description: Saves the current stream position as a return point and enters the shared byte-coded command interpreter. It returns minus one on a clear CIA status bit and zero at the end of the stream.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:0E8A
name: interpret_stream_restore_return_entry
description: Restores the saved return position and enters the shared byte-coded command interpreter. It returns minus one on a clear CIA status bit and zero at the end of the stream.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:0E94
name: interpret_stream_raster_sync_entry
description: Swaps two saved counter words, waits on a raster position and then enters the shared byte-coded command interpreter. It returns minus one on a clear CIA status bit and zero at the end of the stream.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:0EE4
name: interpret_stream_frame_swap_entry
description: Swaps two saved counter words, waits on a raster position and then enters the shared byte-coded command interpreter. It returns minus one on a clear CIA status bit and zero at the end of the stream.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:0F1A
name: interpret_stream_set_flag_entry
description: Sets a control flag to minus one and enters the shared byte-coded command interpreter at the current stream pointer. It returns minus one on a clear CIA status bit and zero at the end of the stream.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:0F26
name: interpret_stream_clear_flag_entry
description: Clears a control flag to zero and enters the shared byte-coded command interpreter at the current stream pointer. It returns minus one on a clear CIA status bit and zero at the end of the stream.

key: birds of prey (1991)(electronic arts)[cr razor](disk 1 of 2)(intro)/Birds of Prey (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr Razor](Disk 1 of 2)(Intro).adf:ar:0:0F30
name: interpret_stream_conditional_entry
description: Branches on a control flag and, when it is clear, skips forward in the stream before entering the shared byte-coded command interpreter. It returns minus one on a clear CIA status bit and zero at the end of the stream.
